reviewScope: Black Whale vessel, spatial, access, operational, structural and scale evidence only

pass1.method: Full-page visual sweep of all 19 ordered pages

pass2.method: Full-resolution verification of retained corridors, thresholds, public areas and security states

retainedPanels.subject: tier-1-corridor-and-threshold
retainedPanels.visualDescription: A long decorated corridor includes an explicitly labeled Room 1009 threshold and multiple guarded transitions.
modelingPermissions: Represent a decorated royal corridor type, a Room 1009 threshold, and guarded transition states.
modelingProhibitions: Do not infer exact corridor length, suite adjacency, room dimensions or guard permanence.

retainedPanels.subject: royal-room-interior
retainedPanels.visualDescription: A large furnished royal interior supports formal seating and multiple occupants.
modelingPermissions: Represent only the confirmed room class and occupiable furnishing zones.
modelingProhibitions: Do not infer a complete floor plan or permanent furniture arrangement.

retainedPanels.subject: lower-tier-multilevel-public-space
retainedPanels.visualDescription: A broad lower-tier public area uses stairs, upper walkways, shopfront-like edges and dense circulation.
modelingPermissions: Represent a multilevel lower-tier public-space class with stairs and elevated circulation.
modelingProhibitions: Do not infer exact deck identity, dimensions, shop count or adjacency.

retainedPanels.subject: commercial-passage
retainedPanels.visualDescription: A crowded passage is lined by service or commercial fronts and supports queuing and pedestrian flow.
modelingPermissions: Represent a lower-tier passage type with active frontage and crowd circulation.
modelingProhibitions: Do not infer specific businesses, exact width or permanent occupancy.

retainedPanels.subject: utilitarian-corridor
retainedPanels.visualDescription: A plainer corridor supports standing groups and short-distance movement between lower-tier spaces.
modelingPermissions: Represent a utilitarian corridor class distinct from the decorated royal corridor.
modelingProhibitions: Do not infer exact tier, route endpoint or corridor length.

retainedPanels.subject: guarded-checkpoint
retainedPanels.visualDescription: Armed personnel control a corridor segment, creating a temporary checkpoint state.
modelingPermissions: Represent the checkpoint as an operational overlay on an existing corridor.
modelingProhibitions: Do not promote personnel placement or barricade state to permanent geometry.

retainedPanels.subject: crowded-service-corridor
retainedPanels.visualDescription: A service-lined corridor carries active foot traffic and repeated frontage openings.
modelingPermissions: Represent a repeated-frontage lower-tier corridor class.
modelingProhibitions: Do not infer exact opening count, spacing, route direction or adjacency.

evidence.claim: A decorated corridor includes a labeled Room 1009 threshold and guarded transitions.
evidence.modelingUse: Use only the confirmed corridor class, label and operational state.

evidence.claim: A large furnished royal interior supports formal seating and multiple occupants.
evidence.modelingUse: Use only the room class and occupiable zones; exact plan remains unknown.

evidence.claim: A lower-tier public space uses stairs and elevated circulation across multiple visible levels.
evidence.modelingUse: Use as a room-class constraint, not a measured layout.

evidence.claim: A crowded passage is lined by active service or commercial fronts.
evidence.modelingUse: Use only the passage type and active-frontage relation.

evidence.claim: A plainer corridor supports lower-tier circulation and standing groups.
evidence.modelingUse: Use as a distinct corridor class without assigning exact tier coordinates.

evidence.claim: Armed personnel create a temporary controlled checkpoint within a corridor.
evidence.modelingUse: Store as an operational overlay, not permanent architecture.

evidence.claim: A service-lined corridor carries active pedestrian traffic past repeated frontage openings.
evidence.modelingUse: Use only the corridor class; exact opening count and spacing remain unknown.

contradictionsAndQuarantines.subject: editorial sequence versus physical adjacency
contradictionsAndQuarantines.rule: Do not promote page or panel order to room adjacency.

contradictionsAndQuarantines.subject: lower-tier location identity
contradictionsAndQuarantines.rule: Do not assign exact tier or deck coordinates without independent confirmation.

contradictionsAndQuarantines.subject: temporary security deployment
contradictionsAndQuarantines.rule: Checkpoint guards and crowd states remain overlays, not geometry.

unresolvedQuestions: Which lower-tier public passages are physically connected?
Does Room 1009 share the same corridor segment shown in prior chapters?

excludedMaterial.reason: Excluded material does not independently establish Black Whale geometry, route, access, infrastructure, scale or durable state evidence.
